name: DataGrid
title: Data Grid

dataRequirements.description: Component is data-agnostic and works with any entity data passed via props

ColumnDef.description: Column definition object for advanced column configuration

header.description: Display header text (defaults to field DisplayName or field name)

render.signature: (value: any, record: object, fieldInfo?: object) => ReactNode
render.description: Custom render function for cell content

sortable.description: Override global sorting setting for this column

properties.name: data
properties.description: Array of records to display. Can be from any source: single entity, joined tables, aggregated results, or any array of objects.

properties.name: entityName
properties.description: Optional entity name for metadata lookup (enables smart formatting for dates, money, value lists) and record opening. With entityPrimaryKeys also set, clicking a row opens that record by itself: you don't need an onRowClick to open it. If omitted, the component uses basic type detection and does not open records.

properties.name: entityPrimaryKeys
properties.description: The entity's real primary key field names (e.g. ['ID'], or ['OrderID', 'LineNumber'] for a composite key), each of which must also be a column on every row. Used for two purposes: (1) React row keys, which keeps keys unique when row.ID is not (for example after a client-side join), and (2) record opening: with entityName set, clicking a row opens the record using row[name] for each key. If the rows carry the key under another name (a query alias such as 'MemberID'), do not list the alias here: in onRowClick set event.cancel = true and open the record yourself with FieldName: 'ID', Value: event.record.MemberID.

constraints.description: When entityName is provided, validates that primary key field names exist on the specified entity
constraints.errorTemplate: Primary key field '{field}' does not exist on entity '{entityName}'

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Array of column definitions. Can be simple strings (field names) for default behavior, or ColumnDef objects for advanced configuration. If not provided, all fields will be displayed. When using ColumnDef objects, the 'field' property is validated against entity fields.
properties.exampleValue: ["Name", { field: "Price", header: "Unit Price", render: (v) => `$${v}`, width: "120px", sortable: true }]

constraints.description: When entityName is provided, validates that column field names (strings or ColumnDef.field properties) exist on the specified entity
constraints.errorTemplate: Column field '{field}' does not exist on entity '{entityName}'

properties.name: pageSize
properties.description: Number of rows per page when paging is enabled

properties.name: showPageSizeChanger
properties.description: Show the page size selector when paging is enabled

properties.name: filterFields
properties.description: Fields to search when filtering. If not specified, searches all fields

constraints.description: When entityName is provided, validates that filter field names exist on the specified entity
constraints.errorTemplate: Filter field '{field}' does not exist on entity '{entityName}'

properties.name: filterDebounceTime
properties.description: Debounce time in ms for filter input

properties.name: longTextDisplay
properties.description: How to display long text that exceeds the threshold: 'truncate' shows ellipsis, 'expand' allows click to expand/collapse, 'tooltip' shows full text on hover, 'wrap' shows all text with wrapping, 'none' uses default behavior

properties.name: longTextThreshold
properties.description: Number of characters before long text display behavior is triggered

properties.name: autoFitColumns
properties.description: When true, columns auto-fit to container width. When false, columns use fixed widths with horizontal scrolling

events.name: rowClick
events.description: Fired when a row is clicked, before the grid's own record open (cancelable event pattern). Use it for selection or other side effects. To open a record yourself, set event.cancel = true first, then call OpenEntityRecord; returning false does not cancel. Never both let the grid open the record and open it again here: the record opens twice.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event object containing the clicked row record and cancel flag. Set cancel = true to prevent default behavior (OpenEntityRecord when entityName and entityPrimaryKeys are provided).

events.name: selectionChanged
events.description: Fired when row selection changes. Callback receives a single object with a selectedRows property.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Object containing the array of selected record objects

events.name: pageChanged
events.description: Fired when page changes. Callback receives a single object with pageNumber, pageSize, and visibleRows.

parameters.name: event
parameters.type: { pageNumber: number, pageSize: number, visibleRows: Array<object> }
parameters.description: Object with 0-based pageNumber, current pageSize, and the array of records visible on the new page

events.name: sortChanged
events.description: Fired when sort configuration changes. Callback receives a single object with a sortState property.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Object with sortState containing the column name and sort direction

events.name: filterChanged
events.description: Fired when filter changes. Callback receives a single object with filterValue and matchingData.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Object with the current filter text and array of all matching records
